Job title: IT Project Manager

We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to lead infrastructure and software delivery projects for a regional healthcare network.

Responsibilities
- Plan and deliver projects using Agile and Scrum
- Manage scope, schedules and budgets in Jira and Microsoft Project
- Lead risk management and stakeholder management across clinical and IT teams
- Coordinate vendors and report progress to the steering committee

Requirements
- 7+ years of project management experience, including 3 years in IT
- PMP certification required
- Strong stakeholder management and communication
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business or a related field

Preferred
- Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
- ITIL Foundation
